items.q: Do I need an account to check a message?
items.a: No. Checking and reporting work without an account. An account adds history and alerts.

items.q: Do you open the link I paste?
items.a: Never. Our server does not visit any link users submit. The verdict is based on the address itself and the data we hold.
You get a protocol number and a private code. The SOC team reviews it, links it to campaigns and requests the domains be taken down.

items.q: If the result is green, am I safe?
items.a: Green means we found no signs of a scam. If you are asked for money or codes, always verify with the institution.

items.q: I paid or shared my card details. What now?
items.a: Call your bank right away to block the card, change your passwords and report it to the police and here.

final.title: Don’t let the scam get through.
final.body: Check, report and help others avoid falling for it.

extensionPage.title: The Mburoja browser extension
extensionPage.description: Scan suspicious emails in Gmail and Outlook in one click.
installSteps: Download the extension package (zip) and unzip it.
Open chrome://extensions and turn on “Developer mode”.
Click “Load unpacked” and choose the extension folder.
Open an email in Gmail or Outlook and click the “Scan” button.
extensionPage.downloadNote: The Chrome Web Store is out of scope for this pilot; the extension is loaded manually.
readsItems: Only the email you open, and only when you click “Scan”
The subject, sender, visible text and links
Attachment names and types (not their contents)
SPF, DKIM, DMARC results if shown
extensionPage.consentBody: Auto-submit is off until you give a one-time consent in the extension popup. After consent: orange, red and dark red send a masked signal report; yellow sends indicators only (domains), no text; green and grey send nothing. You can delete any report within 10 minutes.
signalItems: The subject and first 600 characters, masked
Defanged links and the sender domain
Score, flag, reason codes and version
permissionsItems: storage: keeps the last result and your consent
activeTab and scripting: read the open email only when you click
Access only to mail.google.com, outlook.live.com, outlook.office.com and the Mburoja API
